- Creating an account deletes the sticker you just made

- Watch triple ad before you can actually use the sticker in WhatsApp

reviews.title: Research BEFORE You Download !

Instead it opens to a free trial/subscription page with no way to use basic features without committing. This is getting OLD with corporate owned apps APPLE! However in this case it kept me from making a mistake. Please before downloading, READ THE FULL PRIVACY SECTION / POLICY. If I’m reading it correctly, the data collection seems AGGRESSIVE for a sticker app,read the fine print before you move forward.
